tables.name: perspective_distortion_vs_distance
tables.population: pinhole model; nose-tip to ear-plane depth dz = 0.10 m (assumed adult range 0.09-0.11 m)
tables.notes: Derived: magnification = (d+dz)/d; f = 36*d/0.40 for full-frame with 36 mm side vertical. Higher-resolution sensors allow 85-135 mm at 2-3 m with cropping. Ward et al. 2018 (selfie effect) reportedly found ~30% nasal-base widening at ~30 cm vs ~1.5 m; press-confirmed 2026-11-20 (Rutgers release: ~30% wider nasal base at 12 in vs 5 ft; HealthDay: 30%/29% M/F vs orthographic baseline); dz=0.10 m still unconfirmed.
